# TechAaroorian UI

> Aar Loom is a CSS-only, flat paper design and adaptive layout language. Companion packages provide independently usable behavior with optional React adapters.

Alpha APIs: verify publication and installed versions. The root workspace is private. Repeatable Sections and Asset Gallery are planned.

## Integration and design

- [TechAaroorian UI integration guide for agents](ai/ai-integration.md)
- [Aar Loom design rules](ai/design-rules.md)
- [Aar Loom adaptive design and Yuwbrndr redesign](ai/adaptive-layout.md)
- [Component behavior and styling](ai/styling-boundaries.md)
- [Icons across TechAaroorian UI](ai/icons.md)
- [Independent package versioning](ai/versioning.md)

## Packages and complete examples

- [@techaaroorian-ui/aar-loom](ai/aar-loom.md): Aar Loom: a themeable, CSS-only design language for tools and workspaces. Prepared 0.2.0-alpha.3; check npm availability.
- [@techaaroorian-ui/collection-picker](ai/collection-picker.md): Headless filtered single-selection picker with an optional React listbox hook. Prepared 0.2.0-alpha.1; check npm availability.
- [@techaaroorian-ui/contextual-empty](ai/contextual-empty.md): A contextual, composable empty-state system for React applications. Prepared 0.1.1-alpha.1; check npm availability.
- [@techaaroorian-ui/dialog](ai/dialog.md): Native modal dialog and sheet behavior with an optional React hook. Prepared 0.2.0-alpha.1; check npm availability.
- [@techaaroorian-ui/file-intake](ai/file-intake.md): Atomic file batch validation with structured errors and an optional React adapter. Prepared 0.2.0-alpha.2; check npm availability.
- [@techaaroorian-ui/ordered-collection](ai/ordered-collection.md): Headless ordered selection and item operations with an optional React adapter. Prepared 0.2.0-alpha.1; check npm availability.
- [@techaaroorian-ui/pan-zoom](ai/pan-zoom.md): Headless viewport calculation, auto-fit, and zoom management with optional React hook. Prepared 0.1.0-alpha.1; check npm availability.
- [@techaaroorian-ui/share-state](ai/share-state.md): Zero-server URL state compression and share links via browser CompressionStream with safe byte limits. Prepared 0.1.0-alpha.1; check npm availability.
